prompt.project_info: Create a cheerful photorealistic lifestyle portrait of an approved adult red-haired woman standing in the doorway of a vintage wooden tram.
prompt.main_subject: An approved adult woman with long natural red hair and a warm smile, wearing a patterned sleeveless cropped top with a deep V neckline and high-waisted light denim shorts. She stands holding the tram doorway with both hands and looks toward camera.
prompt.composition_elements: Centered full-body eye-level portrait framed by the wooden tram doorway, vintage interior wood, European city street visible through windows, and existing STOP sign as environmental typography.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Warm golden-hour sunlight, soft shadows, shallow background depth, candid relaxed summery mood and realistic wood, denim, skin, and hair texture.
prompt.technical_specs: 35mm lens, f/2.8, sharp subject with soft city bokeh, 2:3 vertical framing, photorealistic high detail, subtle grain.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a cheerful photorealistic 2:3 lifestyle portrait of an approved adult woman with long natural red hair and a warm smile standing in the doorway of a vintage wooden tram. She wears a patterned sleeveless cropped top with a deep V neckline and high-waisted light denim shorts, holds the doorway naturally with both hands, and looks toward the camera. Center her in the wooden tram doorway, with vintage interior details, European city street visible through the windows, and the existing STOP sign preserved only when its typography is intentionally retained. Use warm golden-hour sunlight, soft shadows, 35mm f/2.8 perspective, sharp subject, soft city bokeh, realistic textures, and subtle grain.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, sexualized framing, erotic pose, minor or child, age ambiguity, celebrity likeness, public-figure likeness, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, random text, altered sign, extra fingers, deformed hands, distorted face
